meta.summary: xmplaylist: ChatGPT promo banner and ad slots, plus channel logo and footer controls
meta.notes:
Checked LIVE on 2026-11-13: rendered DOM of xmplaylist.com home (iPhone UA 390x844 and desktop UA, the same Tailwind page), logged out, captured with headless Chrome; counts were taken on the saved DOM. Fixtures real.html and desktop-real.html are structural captures with text stripped and the channel grid cut to 8 tiles.

LIVE counts: `aside:has(> p > a[href="/connections"])` 1 (matched by its link, not its English text), `ins.adsbygoogle` 3 (covered by the original ads rule), `div.google-auto-placed` 1 (Google auto-ads wrapper), `[role="region"][aria-label="Advertisement"]` 2 desktop / 3 phone (the label is English-only), `[data-view="grid"] img` 179 (one logo per SiriusXM channel), `footer` 1.

The Tailwind classes are unusable; the rules use `aria-label`, `role`, `data-view` and hrefs. The channel grid itself, the primary nav and the station pages' track lists are never hidden. The original cookie and app-banner rules matched nothing and are kept. NOT verified: station and track pages, search, the cookie dialog Google may show in some regions, logged-in state.
